_note: Hand-tuned layer on top of the scraped brand.json (nicceclothing.com, Shopify). Run: python3 tools/build_brand.py --rebuild nicce. Hand-picked images in assets/brand/ are crops of the site's own homepage banners (the NEW SEASON SETS slide, the Shop Hoodies / T-Shirts / Tracksuits category tiles) and a Mercury Collection product lifestyle shot. Logos are the NICCE header wordmark.

scrape._colours: Titles are 'NICCE Name | Colour'; these are the colour segments used on the site.

_instagram: Collected in a browser from the brand's Instagram profile on 2026-10-11 (pinned posts excluded; collaborator-path URLs normalised to /p/<code>/). Thumbnails: assets/ig/N.jpg, square-cropped, max 600px.
name: NICCE
_theme: nicceclothing.com: white page, near-black type, dark grey announcement bar, Epilogue (Google Fonts) throughout with bold uppercase section titles ('LATEST ARRIVALS'), white 'Shop Now' buttons with a black border and 10px radius over imagery, black filled pills for the sign-up tab, product titles 14px semibold, black promo tags ('25% off: Code NEW25'), sale red #f2220a (the SALE nav link and 'UP TO 70% OFF').

pitch.title:
It's pronounced
NICCE.
pitch.copy: A concept for the NICCE app: new season sets and the Mercury Collection in one place, app-only early access on drops, your saved size and Shopify checkout with Apple Pay and Klarna. Tap around, everything works.
list: Shopify checkout with Apple Pay and Klarna

perks: 25% off new arrivals with code: NEW25
_shipping: From nicceclothing.com/pages/delivery-information (UK, checked 11 Oct 2026): Standard 5-7 working days £4.99, free over £60 to UK mainland; Express 1-2 days £6.99 (not Northern Ireland); orders before 2pm Mon-Fri dispatched same day.

notes: FREE standard delivery to UK mainland on orders over £60.
Orders placed before 2pm Monday–Friday are dispatched the same day.

returns.summary: Cancel and return within 14 days of receiving your order. Items must be unused and in their original condition; we refund the full order value within 14 days. Underwear and socks can't be returned for hygiene reasons.

_rewards: NICCE has no loyalty programme (student discount only). The template's Account rewards card is kept as an illustrative app concept (same as the yelir reference build) and its fine print says so; it never claims a real scheme.
_discount: The site's pop-up offers 20% off a first order ('Get 20% Off', code emailed). The app pop-up uses the same 20% with a placeholder app code.

copy.about: It's pronounced 'nee chee'. The name came from playing with 'Niiiice', an expression of joy and support for others; we added the extra 'c' for a 'ch' sound like in cappuccino. Ultimately, we don't care how you pronounce it, as long as you enjoy it!
